#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz as F

def run_case(name, cfg, ops, expect_last=None):
    problems = F.check(cfg, ops)
    if problems:
        print("FAIL", name)
        for p in problems: print("  ", p[:400])
        return False
    return True

ok = True

ops=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":1,"source":0,"length":10}]},
     {"op":"chunk","packets":[{"flow":0,"time":2,"source":0,"length":10}]},
     {"op":"close","flow":0,"time":3}]
ok &= run_case("longer wins", cfg, ops)
